message.content:
The cover of Tempo magazine from October 12–18, 2020, features a grainy illustration of a courtroom or legislative chamber. In the upper-right corner, a faint, white silhouette of an eagle is visible. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters across the top, above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The central illustration shows several figures in dark suits with face masks sitting behind tiered, light-orange desks. All the figures, both on the elevated dais and in the lower seating, have elongated white noses protruding through their masks. On the top level, one figure sits centrally, while another to the right raises a gavel. Below them, rows of figures sit in red-backed chairs, facing away from the viewer towards the front desks. A small Indonesian flag stands on the left side of the main desk.

The main headline reads "SIASAT PINOKIO SENAYAN" in bold, black, sans-serif capitals. Below this, a paragraph of Indonesian text discusses legislative proceedings and the "omnibus law." The bottom-right corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and price information.
